subject.title: feat(android): add inline dictation to chat composer

question: Should Android ship a dedicated composer dictation action that deliberately works only when an on-device recognizer is available?
rationale: The implementation intentionally avoids the system recognizer fallback because that API may use remote recognition, but this leaves the feature unavailable on devices without a local recognizer; code review cannot choose that privacy-versus-availability policy.

options.title: Keep on-device only
options.body: Approve the privacy-preserving scope, require successful on-device transcript proof, and retain the explicit unavailable state on unsupported devices.

options.title: Allow system fallback
options.body: Permit the broader system recognizer only after adding clear privacy disclosure and proof for both local and potentially remote recognition paths.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Do not add a dedicated control until Android recognition availability and supported-device expectations are better established.

recommendation.title: Keep on-device only
recommendation.body: Approve the privacy-preserving scope, require successful on-device transcript proof, and retain the explicit unavailable state on unsupported devices.
